steps.content:
You should **not buy from either** - if you want the manufacturer warranty.

Both pages are for the exact same thing:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**

* Seller A - **Brackmoor Sound**
* Seller B - **Ottervale Audio**

Everything else is identical:
* $129.00
* Customer rating: 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days.
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty.
* Same specs: over-ear, ANC with transparency, 40h battery, USB-C, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, graphite, etc.

The only difference is this claim on the Brackmoor Sound page:

> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

The Ottervale Audio page does not make that claim.

I checked Quellwyn's list of authorized dealers that both pages link to:

https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/zmfwqr/dealers

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

**Neither Brackmoor Sound nor Ottervale Audio is on that list.**

That means:

1. Brackmoor Sound's claim to be an "Authorized Quellwyn dealer" with "Full manufacturer warranty" is false. That is a major red flag for a grey-market / counterfeit risk and untrustworthy seller.

2. Ottervale Audio doesn't make the false claim, but it is also not authorized. Per Quellwyn, you would not get full manufacturer warranty from them either, despite the "1-year limited warranty" stated on the page.

If you want these headphones with the real manufacturer warranty, buy from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics - not from either of these two links.
